headline: CENTIPEDE's wandering menagerie lands on prod
lede: Slot b resumed its half-finished build, cleared a flaky gate, and shipped the arcade's spider, scorpion and fleas to jalfern.com/retrogames/centipede.

notes.text: #3604 shipped as PR #3610 (cd54027): spider re-aims at mushrooms and eats every cap (900/600/300 bravery bands), scorpion poisons full caps and turns centipede segments red at double pace (1000 on one shot), and a bullet flown out of the field summons a flea that rains bonus mushrooms (200).

Proof rode along: centipedechek 59/0 with 32 gates, mutants 17/17 die, and centipedadrive 15/15 in real Chrome — byte-identical seeded rollouts, plus a real bug found and fixed (init() never cleared bullets, so resets leaked stale volleys).

The first static run failed on an unrelated zorkcheck flake (rare shifting-Forest route, 56/57); retry went green and the merge chain completed cleanly. If it strikes again, it earns its own harness issue.
Follow-up filed for the QA lane: #3620 polish pass — authored clover field, wave speed ladder, arcade sound grammar, poison legibility, kill-pop juice.

look.text: Shoot the sky and a flea answers — dodge the spider, race the poisoned reds
